starting_state: Channel 1 plays pattern 1: four trigs on steps 1-4 followed by four empty steps, in an eight-step loop. No masks are set.

steps.caption: Starting point: channel 1 plays pattern 1 in an eight-step loop. Steps 1-4 hold four notes and steps 5-8 are empty. No masks are set. Open Channel tasks with E1, turn E2 to Masks and press K3, then turn E2 to Note. The value reads X.

With no step held, turn E3 right until Note reads C3 (MIDI 60). The channel default replaces the pattern's notes on every step, so all four steps now play C3: read the MIDI strip, which shows C3 four times at the velocities the pattern already had (127, 117, 107, 97).

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Vel and turn E3 right until it reads 80. The channel velocity replaces the pattern's velocities too: the MIDI strip now shows C3 at velocity 80 four times.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Len and turn E3 right until it reads 1/2. The four notes now have a half-step gate. A trig mask has no pattern note of its own, so a trig you add next will use these three channel defaults.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Return to the channel Note field before setting Step 5.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Hold Step 5 and set its stored note to E3.
Release Step 5. Its E3 note is stored, but the step still has no trig, so the loop keeps playing the four C3 notes.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Turn E2 back to Note. Hold step 5 at (5,4), turn E3 right four detents until the screen reads E3 (MIDI 64) and release it. Step 5 now has its own note, but it still has no trig, so nothing new sounds. Then hold K1 and tap step 5, release the step, then release K1. A trig mask now forces step 5 on, so the loop plays a fifth note after the four notes on steps 1-4: E3 (64) at velocity 80, shown in the MIDI strip and by the new lit step 5 on the grid.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Hold K1 and tap step 5 again, release the step, then release K1. The same gesture toggles the trig mask off, so the loop returns to four C3 notes on steps 1-4. Step 5 keeps its note mask but has no trig, so it stays silent.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop
